intro.en: Lideta Subcity Administration is one of the administrative divisions of Addis Ababa City Government. It is responsible for coordinating local governance and supporting public service delivery within its jurisdiction. Operating under the city government framework, the subcity works to ensure accountable administration, effective implementation of municipal policies, and responsive service to the community. The administration is committed to good governance, transparency, and serving the public interest to enhance the well-being of residents.

content.en: Lideta Sub-City is one of the historic and vibrant sub-cities in Addis Ababa. Established with a vision to foster community growth and urban development, Lideta has grown into a hub of commerce, culture, and residential life. Over the years, we have transformed from a traditional neighborhood into a modern urban center while preserving our rich cultural heritage. Our journey is marked by continuous improvement in infrastructure, public services, and community engagement.
content.am: ልደታ ክፍለ ከተማ በአዲስ አበባ ውስጥ ካሉት ታሪካዊ እና ንቁ ክፍለ ከተሞች አንዱ ነው። የማህበረሰብ እድገትን እና የከተማ ልማትን ለማጎልበት በራዕይ የተቋቋመው ልደታ፣ የንግድ፣ የባህል እና የመኖሪያ ማዕከል ሆኗል። በትመታት ውስጥ፣ ባህላዊ ቅርሶቻችንን በመጠበቅ ከባህላዊ ሰፈር ወደ ዘመናዊ የከተማ ማዕከል ተሸጋግረናል። ጉዞአችን በመሰረተ ልማት፣ በህዝብ አገልግሎቶች እና በማህበረሰብ ተሳትፎ ቀጣይነት ያለው መሻሻል ይታይበታል።
content.or: Kutaan Magaalaa Lideta kutaa magaalota seena qabeessaa fi ho'aa Finfinnee keessaa tokko. Guddina hawaasaa fi misooma magaalaa guddisuuf mul'ataan kan hundeeffame, Lideta wiirtuu daldalaa, aadaa fi jireenyaa ta'eera. Waggoota darban keessatti, aadaa keenya isa badhaadhaa osoo eegnuu irraa gara wiirtuu magaalaa ammayyaatti jijjiiramneerra. Imalli keenya fooyya'iinsa itti fufiinsa qabuun bu'uuraalee misoomaa, tajaajila uummataa fi hirmaannaa hawaasaatiin kan beekamudha.

content.en: To provide efficient, transparent, and fair administrative services to residents, fostering social and economic development through community participation.
content.am: ለነዋሪዎች ቀልጣፋ፣ ግልጽ እና ፍትሃዊ አስተዳደራዊ አገልግሎቶችን መስጠት፣ በማህበረሰብ ተሳትፎ ማህበራዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ልማትን ማጎልበት።
content.or: Tajaajila bulchiinsaa siʼataa, ifa fi haqa qabeessa taʼe jiraattotaaf dhiyeessuu, hirmaannaa hawaasaatiin misooma hawaasummaa fi diinagdee guddisuu.

content.en: To see Lideta Sub-City become a model of good governance, prosperity, and livability in Addis Ababa by 2030.
content.am: በ2022 ዓ.ም ልደታ ክፍለ ከተማ በአዲስ አበባ የመልካም አስተዳደር፣ የብልጽግና እና የመኖር ምቹነት ተምሳሌት ሆኖ ማየት።
content.or: Bara 2030tti Kutaan Magaalaa Lideta fakkeenya bulchiinsa gaarii, badhaadhipha fi jireenyaaf mijataa ta'e Finfinnee keessatti arguu.

title.en: II. Questions prepared for the service user community

text.en: Interaction with staff/leaders during service delivery
text.am: 1. አገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ወቅት ከሠራተኞች/ከመሪዎች ጋር የነበረ ግንኙነት ?
text.or: 1. Walitti dhufeenya hojjettoota/hoggantoota waliin yeroo tajaajilaa?

text.en: In terms of providing accurate information by leadership/staff
text.am: 2. የተቋሙ አመራር/ሠራተኞች ትክክለኛ መረጃ ከመስጠት አንፃር ?
text.or: 2. Hoggantoonni/hojjettooni dhaabbatichaa odeeffannoo sirrii kennuu irratti?

text.en: In terms of prioritizing your safety, respect, and general service users by staff/heads
text.am: 3. የተቋሙ ሠራተኞች/ኃላፊ በአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ወቅት ለርስዎ ደህንነት፣ ክብርና አጠቃላይ ለተገልጋዮች ቅድሚያ ከመስጠት አንፃር ?
text.or: 3. Hojjettooni/hogganaan dhaabbatichaa yeroo tajaajilaa nageenya, kabajaafi walumaa galatti tajaajilamtootaaf dursa kennuu irratti?

text.en: In terms of following ethical principles in service delivery
text.am: 4. የተቋሙ ሠራተኞች/ኃላፊ ለተጠቃሚው ህብረተሰብ የሚሰጡት አገልግሎት የሥነምግባር መርሆዎችን ከመከተል አንፃር ?
text.or: 4. Tajaajilli hojjettooni/hogganaan dhaabbatichaa hawaasaaf kennan qajeeltoowwan naamusaa hordofuu irratti?

text.en: To what extent is the service transparent and credible?
text.am: 5. በተቋሙ የሚሰጠው አገልግሎት በተጠቃሚው ህብረተሰብ ዘንድ ግልፅነትና ታማኝነት ያለው በምን ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል?
text.or: 5. Tajaajilli dhaabbaticha keessatti kennamu hawaasa tajaajilamu biratti ifummaa fi amanamummaa qabaachuu irratti sadarkaa maalii irra jira?

text.en: How is the complaint/grievance resolution system evaluated?
text.am: 6. በጽ/ቤቱ የቅሬታ/አቤቱታ አፈታት ስርዓት ስላለው ሁኔታ እንዴት ይገመገማል?
text.or: 6. Haalli sirna hiika komii/iyyataa waajjirichaa akkamitti gamaaggamama?

text.en: How fast was the response to your complaint/grievance?
text.am: 7. በተቋሙ ቅሬታ/አቤቱታ አቅርበው ምላሽ ያገኙበት ፍጥነት ምን ያህል ነው?
text.or: 7. Saffisni deebii komii/iyyata dhaabbatichaaf dhiyeessitanii argattan hammamii?

text.en: In terms of solving good governance problems and ensuring accountability?
text.am: 8. የመልካም አስተዳደር ችግሮች በመፍታትና ተጠያቂነትን ማስፈን ከመሪውም አንጻር?
text.or: 8. Rakkoolee bulchiinsa gaarii hiikuu fi itti gaafatamummaa mirkaneessuu irratti hogganaa birattis?

text.en: What is the level of reception and hospitality?
text.am: 9. የጽ/ቤቱ ኃላፊና ሠራተኞች የተገልጋይ አቀባበልና መስተንግዶ ምን ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል ?
text.or: 9. Simannaa fi keessummeessaan hoogganaa fi hojjettoota waajjirichaa sadarkaa maalii irra jira?

text.en: How does the office look in terms of giving immediate response/decision?
text.am: 10. የልደታ ክፍለ ከተማ የመልካም አስተዳደር፣ ቅሬታና አቤቱታ ጽ/ቤት አፋጣኝ ምላሽ ውሳኔ ከመስጠት አንፃር ምን ይመስላል?
text.or: 10. Waajjirri Bulchiinsa Gaarii, Komii fi Iyyataa Kutaa Magaalaa Lidetaa murtoo deebii hatattamaa kennuu irratti maal fakkaata?

text.en: How is it evaluated in terms of working following appropriate directives?
text.am: 11. የተቋሙ ጽ/ቤት ኃላፊና ሠራተኞች ለተጠቃሚው ህብረተሰብ ቅሬታ/አቤቱታ የሚሰጡት አግባብ መመሪያ ተከትሎ ከመሥራት አንፃር እንዴት ይገመገማል?
text.or: 11. Hoogganaa fi hojjettooni waajjira dhaabbatichaa komii/iyyata hawaasa fayyadamuuf kennan qajeelfama sirrii hordofanii hojjechuu irratti akkamitti gamaaggamama?

description.am: ፈጣን፣ አስተማማኝ እና ቀለል ያሉ አገልግሎቶችን ቀርፋፋ አድርገን እናቀርባለን፤ ይህም ጊዜ ለመቆጠብ እና ሁሉም ሂደት ለማህበረሰቡ ቀላል እንዲሆን የተነደፈ ነው።
description.or: Tajaajila ariifaa, amanamaa, fi laaffisaa yeroo danda'uuufi dhimmi hundaa hawaasaaaf laaffisa ta'uuf qopheessine kennina.

description.en: We adopt modern tools and digital solutions to improve service delivery and create smarter, more accessible public services.
description.am: አገልግሎት አቅርቦትን ለማሻሻል እና ይበልጥ ብልህ እና ተደራሽ የሆኑ የህዝብ አገልግሎቶችን ለመፍጠር ዘመናዊ መሳሪያዎችን እና ዲጂታል መፍትሄዎችን እንቀበላለን።
description.or: Meezjii har'aaafi furmaata dijitaalaa fayyadanna kennumsa tajaajilaa fooyyessuufi tajaajila ummataa ogummaa qabuufi dhaqqabamuu taasifachuuf.

description.en: We take your feedback seriously. Submit your complaint or suggestion through our secure online system.
description.am: የእርስዎን አስተያየት በከባድ እንወስዳለን። ቅሬታዎን ወይም ሀሳብዎን በአረጋጋጭ የመስመር ላይ ስርአታችን ያስገቡ።
description.or: Deebii keessan gadi dhiifnaan ilaalla. Ragaa ykn yaada keessan tura online sirnaa keenya tiin dhiyaadhaa.

subtitle.en: Get in touch with us for more information

description.en: We're here to help! Whether you have a question about our services, need assistance with your account, or want to provide feedback, our team is ready to assist you.
description.am: እኛ እርስዎን ለመርዳት እዚህ ነን! ስለ አገልግሎቶቻችን ጥያቄ ካለዎት፣ በመለያዎ እርዳታ ከፈለጉ፣ ወይም አስተያየት መስጠት ከፈለጉ፣ ቡድናችን እርስዎን ለመርዳት ዝግጁ ነው።
description.or: Gargaaruf as jirra! Yoo tajaajila keenya irratti gaaffi qabaattan, akkaawuntii keessan irratti gargaarsa barbaaddan, yookiin deebii kennuu feetan, gareen keenya isin gargaaruf qophaa'e dha.

subtitle.en: Cases where the standard complaint procedure does not apply to Order No. 143/2015
subtitle.am: መደበኛ የቅሬታ አቀራረብ ሂደት በደንብ ቁጥር 143/2015 ተፈፃሚ የማይሆኑባቸው ጉዳዮች
subtitle.or: Dhimmoota hojimaanni komii idilee galmeessisuu, Dambii Lakk.143/2015 raawwatiinsa hin qabne

items.en: Cases that are stipulated in other laws regarding complaint submittal and decision making; cases lodged or pending cases or cases presumed to be lodged in regular courts of law and quasi-judicial organs, or decisions or orders given by the thereof.
items.am: በሌላ ሕግ ስለአቤቱታ አቀራረብና አወሳሰን የተደነገገ ከሆነ፣ በመደበኛ ፍርድ ቤትና መሰል በሕግ የመዳኘት ሥልጣን በተሰጠው ተቋም ዘንድ ቀርቦ በመታየት ላይ ያለ ወይም ቀርቦ መታየት ያለበትን ጉዳይ ወይም በእነዚህ ተቋማት የተሰጠ ውሳኔ ወይም ትዕዛዝ፣
items.or: 1 .Dhimmoota hojimaanni komii idilee galmeessisuu, Dambii Lakk.143/2015 raawwatiinsa hin qabne

items.en: Cases being handled by an organ that has a judicial power, office of the auditor general, or activities related to an ongoing criminal investigation.
items.am: በሕግ የመዳኘት ሥልጣን በተሰጠው አካል፣ በዋና ኦዲተር መሥሪያ ቤት የተያዙ ጉዳዮች ወይም እየተካሄደ ያለ የወንጀል ምርመራ ተግባር፣
items.or: 2. Dhimmoota qaama seeraan hayyamameen, Waajjira Odiitara Muummichaatiin, ykn qorannoo yakkaa gaggeeffamaa jiruun ilaalamaa jiran, .

items.en: Matters decided by or pending issues with the council or standing committees of the council, judicial and public prosecutors administrative councils.
items.am: በምክር ቤት ወይም በምክር ቤቱ ቋሚ ኮሚቴ፣ በዳኞችና በዐቃብያነ ሕግ አስተዳደር ጉባኤ በመታየት ላይ ያለ ወይም የታየ ጉዳይ፣
items.or: 3. Dhimma Mana Maree ykn Koree Dhaabbii Mana Marichaa, Yaa’ii Bulchiinsa Abbootii Seeraa fi Abbaa Alangaatiin ilaalamaa jiru ykn ilaalamaa ture, .

items.en: Matters decided by or pending with the federal institutions; or matters under the jurisdiction of federal institutions.
items.am: በፌዴራል ተቋም በመታየት ላይ ያለ ጉዳይ ወይም የተወሰነ ውሳኔ ወይም በፌዴራል ተቋም ሥልጣን ሥር የሆነ ጉዳይ፣
items.or: 4. Dhimma ilaalamaa jiru yookiin murtii dhaabbata federaalaatiin kenname yookiin dhimma aangoo dhaabbata federaalaa jala jiru, .

items.en: Even if the submitted grievance or complaint falls under the jurisdiction of the office, pending matters at the public office or matters that the public office does not give final decisions for.
items.am: የቀረበው ቅሬታ ወይም አቤቱታ በጽህፈት ቤቱ ሥልጣን ሥር ቢሆንም በመንግሥት ያለ ወይም መሥሪያ ቤት እየታየ የመጨረሻው ሳኔ በመሥሪያ ቤቱ ያልተሰጠበት ጉዳይ፣
items.or: 5. Himannaan ykn komiin dhiyaate aangoo mana hojichaa keessa ta'us dhimma aangoo mootummaa jala jiru ykn Waajjirri mul'achaa jiru, yeroo dhumaaf waajjirri hin kennamne, .

items.en: Notwithstanding matters to be referred to the office by the mayor, pending grievance and complaint that was submitted to the cabinet of the city.
items.am: ከንቲባው ለጽህፈት ቤቱ የሚመራው እንደተጠበቀ ቀርቦ ሆኖ እየታየ ለከተማውካቢኔ ቅሬታወይም ያለ አቤቱታ፤
items.or: 6. Kantiibaan akka itti gaafatamaa waajjiraatti ilaalamaa jira, kaabinee magaalichaas akka komii ykn komiitti ilaalamaa jira;

items.en: Grievance and complaint to be submitted regarding revenues, finance, grievances of civil servants, and contractual agreements.
items.am: በገቢዎች፣ በፋይናንስ፣ በመንግስት ሠራተኞች ቅሬታና የኮንትራት ውልን በተመለከተ የሚቀርቡ ቅሬታ ወይም አቤቱታ፡፡
items.or: 7. Galii, faayinaansii, hojjettoota mootummaa, fi waliigaltee ilaalchisee komii ykn komii ka’u.
